dsh-mistral-search
Web search for DeepSeek Harness,
through Mistral.
This plugin answers DeepSeek Harness web_search calls with Mistral's built-in web search.
Search uses only your Mistral key. You do not need a DeepSeek key or the Vibe program.
This is a community plugin, not an official DeepSeek or Mistral project.
Turning on web search carries a security risk. Read Security first.

## How it works
Mistral documents no search API that works without a model. So the plugin sends one short conversati
on per query and takes the results that the built-in web search tool found.
Your search terms go to Mistral. `store: false` asks Mistral not to keep the conversation. Responses
measured in November 2026 label their results with `source: brave`, which suggests Mistral passes q
ueries on to Brave Search. Mistral does not document this.
## Security
Turning on web search always carries a security risk. Search results come from web pages that anyone
can write, and a page can hold instructions that trick the model (prompt injection). Mistral's safe
ty filter or the search engine may remove some of this, but you cannot rely on them to remove all of
ilter or the search engine may remove some of this, but you cannot rely on them to remove all of it.
- The risk is highest in a full access session. A tricked model can run commands without approval an
d read anything your account can read, including the Mistral key and other credentials. Use a permis
sion that asks for approval, such as workspace write. The risk does not go away under that permissio

n.
- The model can put your work into search terms, and search terms go to Mistral. Turn the plugin

off for sensitive work.
- A tricked model can repeat searches and use up your allowance. The plugin
has no limit on the number of searches. If pay-as-you-go is on, this can reach your prepaid credits.
- If you think the key has leaked, issue a new one at Mistral.
## Install
### Prepare a key
Store your Mistral key as `MISTRAL_VIBE_API_KEY` in the Harness credential store, or set it as an en
vironment variable before launch. To use another name, change `apiKeyEnv`. Without a key, the Harnes
s hides `web_search` from the model.

Restart the web server.
### Desktop
In the app, open **Plugins → Add plugin** and enter the address below. When the install finishes, pr
ess **Enable now**. The app manages the desktop profile, so `dsh plugin --profile desktop` is refuse
s **Enable now**. The app manages the desktop profile, so `dsh plugin --profile desktop` is refused.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
## Cost
Mistral's web search is not free. Mistral states that every API key uses your organization's plan an
d pay-as-you-go settings. Included monthly usage is shared across Studio, the API and Vibe Code and
is used first. After that, usage draws on prepaid credits if pay-as-you-go is on, and can stop until
the next billing period if it is off. The plugin cannot read these settings, so check them yourself
in the API keys and Subscriptions documents.
One `web_search` call can hold up to 4 queries, and each query counts separately. A retry sends a se
cond request. In a small sample from November 2026, a query usually took about 800 input tokens, 5,0
00 to 8,500 search result tokens and 20 to 70 output tokens. This plugin's share of plan usage has n
ot been measured in isolation.
## Settings
All settings are optional. Set them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Setting | Meaning |

| `model` | The model that runs the search |
| `apiKeyEnv` | The name that holds the key. Never writ

e the key itself |
| `baseURL` | The Mistral API address. The key is sent to it, so only HTTPS is ac
cepted. HTTP is allowed on localhost only |
Some models do not accept the built-in web search. Measured in November 2026 with a Vibe key, `mistr
al-small-latest` worked, and `deepseek-v4-1-flash-1017`, `ministral-3b-latest` and `ministral-14b-la
test` were refused with HTTP 400 (code 3004). Model cards can differ from this.
## Limits
- Legitimate topics can be blocked. In November 2026, `prompt injection attack examples`, `OWASP LLM
01 prompt injection mitigation` and `ignore previous instructions meme origin` were blocked, so this
plugin is a poor fit for research on that subject. Mistral does not say what triggers the block, an

d how often other searches are blocked was not measured.
- When one query is blocked, the other quer
ies in the call still run. The Harness merges sources into one list, so another query's sources can

appear under the blocked query's heading.
- Search cards can show `<strong>` tags as text, because t

he plugin passes on Mistral's summary unchanged.
- Mistral is the only engine. A failed search does

not move to another engine.
- Results come from `info.result`, a field Mistral does not document. If
it goes away, the plugin uses citation chunks. If those are also missing, the plugin reports an err

or and does not treat the search as empty.
[该节后续省略]
## What was tested
Tests ran on Windows 11, Node.js 24 and DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1.
| Item | Method |
| Install from `github:`, HTTPS and Release `.tgz` addresses, bundle registration, removal | Public

repository, web profile, isolated home |
| Install from the desktop **Add plugin** screen, enabling,

Running status | Public repository, isolated home, no key |
| Hiding the tool without a key, retry,

cancel | `github:` install, isolated home, fake API, plus a Harness integration test |
| Real searc

h, block notice, `web_fetch` | Vibe key, web |
| Real search, block notice | Vibe key, desktop |
Real searches used a copy placed in the runtime folder. No real Mistral search has run on a package
installed from the public repository. Keys other than a Vibe key, macOS and Linux were not tested.
The code is in `lib/search.js` and `lib/index.js`. `npm test` runs offline and needs no install. Rep
ort problems in Issues.
